services.title: Issuance of CTC for Deputized Officers
services.description: Issuance of Community Tax Certificates to deputized officers for onward issuance, against a Requisition and Issue Voucher.

requirements.item: Four (4) Original Copies of duly accomplished Requisition and Voucher Form
Four (4) Original Copies of duly accomplished Invoice and Receipt of Accountable Form

steps.client: Present the Requisition and Issue Voucher (RIV) and the Invoice and Receipt of Accountable Forms.
steps.agency: Verify that all entries are complete, approve the requisition, and record the serial numbers of the CTCs.

steps.client: Present the Requisition and Issue Voucher for approval.
steps.agency: Issue the RIV, Invoice, Logbook and CTCs.

steps.client: Present the RIV, Invoice, Logbook and CTCs at the City Auditor’s Office.
steps.agency: Verify the serial numbers of the CTCs.

steps.client: Return to the Administrative Division and present the verified documents.
steps.agency: Receive the verified documents and release the CTCs.
